born.why: This code prioritizes learning via tasting for new fruits, strictly avoiding species with high poisoning rates (>30% harm), and switches to carrying safe fruits to the pantry when hunger is low to optimize long-term survival.

This code prioritizes eating known-safe fruits to save time, uses 'taste' for novel fruits when hunger is manageable to gather data without high risk, and avoids known-poisonous fruits unless near starvation, balancing safety with the need to forage.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when near death, uses a majority vote of diary entries to distinguish safe from poisonous fruits, and prefers tasting novel items only when hunger is manageable to avoid wasting time on unknowns while starving.

The code prioritizes immediate survival at critical hunger levels, uses a majority-vote safety check against known poisons, and strategically tastes novel fruits to expand dietary knowledge only when safe enough to risk the small cost.

The code prioritizes learning via tasting for unknown fruits when safe to do so, avoids known poisons unless starving, and eats known-safe fruits efficiently, balancing survival needs with long-term energy optimization.

The code prioritizes carrying known-safe food home, uses tasting only when hunger is moderate to learn new fruits safely, and avoids poisonous species based on historical harm counts, balancing exploration with survival.

This code prioritizes survival by avoiding known poisonous fruits unless starvation is imminent, uses tasting to learn about novel fruits safely when hunger allows, and eats known-safe or high-value targets to maintain energy levels.

Prioritizes survival by eating anything when hunger is critical (>95), avoids known poisonous fruits unless starving, learns from novel fruits by tasting only when safe (low hunger), and eats known good foods immediately to maintain energy levels.
